title: Running Costs, Touchscreen Use, and Miscellaneous Issues
summary: The topic combines comments about economical running costs with complaints about touchscreen-dependent controls and a few vague or context-poor mentions of issues and cheaper versions.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car for being economical or enjoyable to run.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize anticipated or possible issues, expired in-car media costs, and the shift to having key functions run through the touchscreen.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention cheaper running, cheaper versions, owning two cars, or touchscreen operation without enough context to confirm clear sentiment.

limitations: This cluster mixes unrelated subjects, including running costs, touchscreen controls, subscription/media cost, and generic mentions of issues or cheaper versions.
Several fragments are too short or lack context to determine clear sentiment beyond the assigned label.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all F70 feedback.
